# MySQL Connector/J corresponding source

`lib/mysql-connector-j-26.7.0.jar` is the unmodified driver from the same local MySQL Connector/J 26.7.0 distribution as `third_party/mysql-connector-j-26.7.0/`. The binary SHA-256 is `69084713593a4aa8d07c383619b9639276f08bccf8faf1c562178147d389b1e1`.

The vendor source, build scripts, version information, and license are preserved here. The duplicate distribution JAR and test-only connection/TLS configuration are omitted; no vendor implementation files are modified. The application's runtime driver remains under `lib/`.

Read the vendor LICENSE and `lib/CONNECTOR-LICENSE.txt` for the driver's existing terms and third-party notices. No new license is assigned to TapIn by repository preparation.
